conviction_note: The filings index and the shareholder record agree that MIND announced no new orders at all during the May-July quarter, which for an order-driven microcap is the whole print; that argues for a sixth consecutive negative reaction, but the stock already closed at its 52-week low on the print day so I take a sixth of the 24% median rather than half of it.

findings.finding: MIND made no order or contract announcement during its entire fiscal Q2 (May-July 2026): the only 8-K accepted between the 2026-04-15 results filing and the print is item 5.07 (annual meeting results, accepted 2026-07-23T20:15:17Z), and the shareholder record independently describes 'a prolonged absence of new order announcements' (2026-08-25), 'still radio silence, what's the plan?' (2026-07-28) and 'another quarter with basically no material announcements in it' (2026-06-10) - this after management told the Q1 call that pending bids carried backlog potential exceeding the then-current $13.9m backlog 'by multiples'.
findings.why_not_priced: The bull case on this name is entirely a pipeline conversion story - the digest is full of it ('imminent orders', 'potential +$10 million upcoming orders', 'Project Vault', the 2027/2028 ramp) - and the test of that story is whether orders are being signed now. A zero-order quarter is verifiable from the filings index in thirty seconds and is nowhere summarised; there is no analyst, no consensus and no preview for this name anywhere in the capture. If it were priced I would not expect a poster on 2026-09-01 to be writing 'something tells me we've got a surprise order pending and it may be close to $10.2M just kinda feeling it', two days before the print.
findings.independence: Two supports, both from inside the same digest, so they are one source cluster with the quotes above and should be collapsed - only the filings-index absence is genuinely independent. First, the peer read is not helpful either: TGS's Q2 2026 operational update, quoted on 2026-07-08 at https://www.tgs.com/press-releases/tgs-q2-2026-operational-and-financial-update, has its CEO saying 'the de-escalation of the conflict in the Middle East has resulted in lower oil prices' with exploration growth framed as 'over the coming years' rather than now. Second, a poster tracking the semi-monthly short-interest reports records the short base falling from 968,000 shares to 568,000 (2026-06-26) to 440,000 (2026-07-13) to 415,000 (2026-08-27), a 57% decline - so the slide to the 52-week low has been long liquidation with the short covering into it, which removes the squeeze mechanism from any upside tail and is why my high bound is only +8% on a name that has printed +42% and +26% reactions before.

searched_and_found_nothing: any equity issuance in the run-in, which is the one thing that would have made me more negative: MIND filed a 424B5 with an 8-K items 1.01/7.01/8.01 on 2025-09-02, a week before the September 2025 print that then fell 14.5%, and there is no 2026 analogue - no 424B5, no S-3, no EFFECT notice

any evidence the $4m repurchase authorisation has been used, which the digest complains about repeatedly at sub-$5 prices; no filing discloses execution and the only supporting claim is a retail observation of 40-60k shares bought on the ask on 2026-08-17

confirmation of the Midwood Capital 12.69% stake asserted in three posts of 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-01: those posts say the figure comes from asking an AI model, and there is no 13D or 13G of any kind for this issuer in the 400-day lookback, so I discarded it
a consistent backlog number: the digest variously reports $7.5m, $13.9m, $7.6m and 'around $7.6 million to $26 million', which I could not reconcile without the 10-Q text

the six Form 4s accepted within two minutes on 2026-07-31: they match the six filed on 2025-10-08 and land eight days after the annual meeting, so they read as the routine director grant batch rather than a signal, and no bodies are stored to check
any read on the MUSV or Project Vault opportunities, the DFARS rare-earth rule change or NOAA contracts that the digest builds its 2027 case on - none of it appears in a filing or a company release
an option-implied move or any positioning datapoint: none exists for this name in the capture
baseline_tension: It agrees with everything the baseline shows - five consecutive negative reactions (-5.4%, -28.5%, -24.1%, -14.5%, -10.8%), a 20-day run-in of -16.33%, and a close exactly at the 52-week low on the print day - which is the reason to be suspicious of it, and the reason I sized at a sixth of the 24.06% median instead of taking the base rate at face value.
corpus_limits: Fifty-two captured items, of which fifty are EDGAR index entries; no news channel, no filing or 10-Q body text, no consensus, no option chain, no official short-interest file. Both stored bodies are StockTwits digests dominated by one or two prolific and openly hostile posters, so the qualitative colour is one-sided and I have leaned only on the parts that are checkable against filings or dated third-party releases. The order-drought finding is an argument from absence in the filings index, which cannot distinguish 'no orders' from 'orders not announced by 8-K'. quote.json's 2026-09-08 bar ($4.3575 at 15:08 UTC) predates this amc print and is usable, but it disagrees with the baseline's $4.20 close for the same day, so the stock fell roughly 8% during the session before the release - a pre-print fact I have used only as confirmation. No tripwire-flagged document appeared in this capture.
